title: As AI content floods the internet, Pangram raises $9M to detect it
description: Pangram has raised $9 million to scale its AI detection software. The startup has also released a new AI text detection model, Pangram 4, and an AI image detection model in research preview.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
description: The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight
description: Spur Intelligence has raised a $200 million round from Insight Partners for its tech that can identify legit human traffic from bots.
author: Julie Bort

title: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea
description: Runlayer is suing Rippling after Rippling evaluated the startup's MCP  gateway product and then opted to build one itself.
author: Julie Bort

title: Sam Altman is ready to decelerate
description: His change of position comes after "the first security incident that I have felt very viscerally."
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid
description: The largest grid operator in the U.S. says it will cut power to large data centers to prevent blackouts starting next year.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
description: Since launching last year, the startup today has more than 8 million people using the open-source or hosted version of its models, and now generates annual recurring revenue of $21 million.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410 million compute deal with Amazon
description: Recursive’s $400 million outlay represents the bulk of the company’s fundraising to date.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
description: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
description: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.
author: Julie Bort

title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
description: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.
author: Julie Bort

title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
description: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.
author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai

title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system
description: Microsoft bolstered its AI cybersecurity offerings this week with the launch of its first AI security model and a new security platform.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
description: OpenAI's Hugging Face breach has reignited debate over AI alignment and control, exposing competing views on whether increasingly capable AI should be better aligned, better contained, or both.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Threads users can now chat with Meta AI in their DMs
description: Meta on Monday said it is rolling out its Meta AI chatbot within Threads' DMs, giving users a way to chat with the AI assistant.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Google’s AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
description: Google’s AI Overviews now appear in 43% of searches, underscoring how quickly AI-generated answers are becoming the default way people discover information online.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Power up your AI infrastructure! A first look at the Smart Systems Stage agenda at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
description: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the Smart Systems Stage will be where energy, infrastructure, and technology collide, covering everything from fusion breakthroughs to the grid strain AI is putting on the entire economy.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps
description: This $9 NFC key requires you to physically scan it to unlock distracting apps on your phone.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Ilya Sutskever’s Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale its AI research
description: After two years in stealth, Safe Superintelligence has announced a long-term partnership with Nvidia as it prepares to scale to its next phase.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Enigma raises $70M to make controlling a robot as easy as adjusting the volume
description: The massive seed round was led by  Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, with participation from Sarah Guo's Conviction Partners.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
description: Forget YouTube videos—frontier physical AI models need multiple camera angles, dense annotation, and soon, brain wave readings.
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Making sense of the panic over Chinese AI
description: On the latest episode of Equity, we discussed why Moonshot AI's Kimi seemed to panic Silicon Valley and Wall Street.
author: Anthony Ha

title: Hugging Face CEO calls for ‘radical transparency’ after ‘unprecedented’ OpenAI hack
description: "The first autonomous agent cyberattack is an unprecedented event. It deserves an unprecedented response!"
author: Anthony Ha

title: Monday.com is the latest tech company to blame AI for layoffs — here are 20 others
description: A running look — in reverse chronological order — at the bigger tech companies that have announced significant layoffs this year with AI as a stated factor.
author: Rebecca Bellan, Connie Loizos

title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
description: At libraries around the country, "Avoiding AI" workshops have elicited unprecedented demand.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: One fallen power line exposed a growing AI data center problem. Here’s how to fix it.
description: A close call in Northern Virginia revealed just how poorly data centers respond to grid disruptions. Here's how to fix the problem.
author: Tim De Chant

title: I tried out OpenAI’s new AI keypad — which will be fun for some coders and slightly mystifying to everyone else
description: OpenAI's fancy new AI keypad will be a lot of fun for some, while many others are probably not going to touch it.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
description: The neolab is betting that automating routine computer tasks will soon outpace coding as AI's biggest use case.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
description: AI coding startup Cognition has acquired Poke, the AI assistant you text like a friend, in a deal valuing the startup in the low nine figures. The acquisition brings Poke’s conversational style and interaction model to Cognition’s coding agent Devin, reflecting a growing belief that how AI assistants interact with users is as important as the models powering them.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
description: Opus 5 will be both cheaper and less restrictive than Fable, likely making it preferable in most use cases.
author: Russell Brandom
